intro: The Spicy Chicken + Avocado Pita from CAVA combines bold Mediterranean flavors with creamy avocado and fiery harissa honey chicken. This handheld meal from the [CAVA Curated Pitas Menu](/menu/curated-pitas) delivers 48g of protein and 930 calories, making it a satisfying option for spice lovers. Priced at $13.95 to $15.45, this pita balances heat, creaminess, and fresh vegetables in every bite.
priceCalories: The Spicy Chicken + Avocado Pita costs between $13.95 and $15.45 depending on location. At 930 calories, it provides substantial energy with 48g of protein, 80g of carbohydrates, and 48g of fat. This makes it one of the heartier options on the [full CAVA menu](/), ideal for those seeking a filling meal with robust nutritional content and bold flavors.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets this pita apart is the combination of harissa honey chicken with fresh avocado and skhug sauce. The harissa provides smoky heat while honey adds sweetness, balanced by creamy avocado. Pickled onions contribute tanginess, and skhug delivers an herbaceous kick. This layering of flavors creates complexity rarely found in quick-service pitas, making it a standout choice.
nutritionFacts: With 930 calories, this pita delivers 48g of protein for muscle maintenance and satiety. The 80g of carbohydrates provide energy, while 48g of fat comes from nutritious sources like avocado and hummus. For detailed nutritional breakdowns and customization options, visit the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) to adjust ingredients based on your dietary needs and preferences.
whatsInside: This pita features warm pita bread filled with harissa honey chicken, creamy hummus, fresh avocado slices, pickled onions, shredded romaine, and skhug sauce. The harissa honey chicken serves as the protein base, while hummus from the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/dips-spreads) adds richness. Fresh vegetables provide crunch and the skhug brings herbaceous heat to complete the flavor profile.
tasteLike: Expect a bold flavor journey starting with the sweet-spicy harissa chicken, followed by buttery avocado that mellows the heat. The skhug adds bright, herby spiciness while pickled onions provide acidic crunch. Hummus contributes earthy creaminess, and romaine adds fresh texture. The pita bread ties everything together, creating a harmonious blend of Mediterranean spices and fresh ingredients.
customize: Personalize your pita by adjusting spice levels or swapping proteins from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/mains). Add extra vegetables from the [CAVA Toppings Menu](/toppings) like cucumber, tomatoes, or cabbage. Request extra skhug for more heat or substitute with tzatziki for a cooling effect. You can also add feta cheese or modify the base hummus for your preferred flavor combination.
pairsWell: Complement this spicy pita with cooling options from the [CAVA Sides Menu](/sides) like pita chips with tzatziki or a simple side salad. Balance the heat with refreshing beverages from the [CAVA Drinks Menu](/drinks) such as mint lemonade or hibiscus tea. For dessert, try a sweet treat from the [CAVA Desserts Menu](/desserts) to finish your meal perfectly.
healthyChoice: This pita offers 48g of protein, supporting muscle health and fullness. Avocado provides heart-healthy monounsaturated fats and fiber, while romaine adds vitamins and minerals. However, at 930 calories and 48g of fat, it is a substantial meal best suited for active individuals. Those monitoring sodium should note the pickled onions and sauces contribute significant amounts.
howToOrder: Order the Spicy Chicken + Avocado Pita at any [CAVA Locations](/locations) by selecting it from the Curated Pitas section. Specify any modifications upfront, such as extra skhug or no pickled onions. You can also build a similar combination using the custom pita option, choosing each component individually. Online ordering allows you to review nutritional information before checkout.
vsAlternatives: Compared to the Greek Chicken Pita at 720 calories, this option provides 210 more calories with added avocado and spicier flavor. The Steak + Feta Pita at 820 calories offers similar richness but with beef instead of chicken. The Crispy Falafel Pita at 750 calories provides a vegetarian alternative with less protein. This pita stands out for its unique harissa-skhug spice combination.
whoShouldTry: Perfect for spice enthusiasts who enjoy layered heat from both harissa and skhug. Active individuals needing substantial protein and calories will appreciate the 48g protein content. Those who love Mediterranean flavors with a kick should definitely try this pita. However, individuals with heat sensitivity or those following low-calorie diets may prefer milder options from the menu.
worthTrying: The Spicy Chicken + Avocado Pita is absolutely worth trying for its expertly balanced heat and creaminess. At $13.95 to $15.45, you receive generous portions of quality ingredients including fresh avocado and well-seasoned chicken. The unique combination of harissa honey chicken with skhug offers flavors not commonly found together. For spice lovers seeking a satisfying, protein-rich meal, this pita delivers excellent value.

faqs.q: How spicy is the Spicy Chicken + Avocado Pita?
faqs.a: This pita has moderate to high heat from both harissa honey chicken and skhug sauce. The harissa provides smoky, sweet heat while skhug adds bright, herbaceous spiciness. The avocado and hummus help balance the heat, but it is still quite spicy. You can request less skhug or substitute milder sauces if you prefer less heat.

faqs.q: Can I make the Spicy Chicken + Avocado Pita less spicy?
faqs.a: Yes, you can customize the spice level by asking for no skhug or requesting it on the side. You can also substitute the harissa honey chicken with grilled chicken for a milder protein option. Adding extra avocado or hummus will further tone down the heat while maintaining delicious Mediterranean flavors throughout the pita.

faqs.q: Is the Spicy Chicken + Avocado Pita gluten-free?
faqs.a: No, the pita bread contains gluten. However, you can enjoy the same ingredient combination as a bowl by ordering it over greens or grains. Check the [CAVA Gluten Free Menu](/gluten-free) for suitable base options. The chicken, avocado, hummus, and vegetables are naturally gluten-free, making a bowl conversion an excellent alternative.

faqs.q: What allergens are in the Spicy Chicken + Avocado Pita?
faqs.a: This pita contains wheat from the pita bread and sesame from the hummus. It may also contain traces of other allergens depending on preparation. For comprehensive allergen information including cross-contamination details, consult the [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu) or speak with staff about your specific dietary needs and concerns.

faqs.q: How does this compare to other items on the CAVA Curated Pitas Menu?
faqs.a: At 930 calories, this is one of the heartier pitas available, offering more calories than the Greek Chicken Pita (720 cal) but less than some custom options. It provides the highest spice level among curated pitas and features unique ingredients like fresh avocado. The 48g protein content makes it the most protein-rich standard pita option.
